item.title: Past White House adviser Raj Panjabi has written a playbook for 'living room' crises
item.description: Dr. Raj Panjabi is the author of Safer: A Playbook. His goal is to help people face a personal crisis — health, workplace, family conflicts — and "turn fear into action."

item.title: After cancer surgery, Pope Leo embarks on Latin America trip
item.description: Pope Leo XIV is kicking off a three-nation tour of Latin America with a visit to Uruguay, three weeks after undergoing lung cancer surgery that had put the entire trip into question.

item.title: A judge blocks construction of Trump's arch moments after it won federal approval
item.description: The Trump administration hoped to begin construction immediately after a federal panel approved its arch late Thursday. But just after midnight, the judge issued an order blocking work for 14 days.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: With humor, heart and homunculi, 'Small Prophets' is a gentle marvel
item.description: A man calls forth magical spirits in an effort to find his long-missing girlfriend in this new British comedy-fantasy. Original and surprising, Small Prophets imbues daily life with poetic touches.

item.title: Min Jin Lee on 'American Hagwon' and why it takes a decade to write each novel
item.description: Lee's new novel is about the promise and perils for Koreans who pursue a Western education. Her previous book, the 2017 novel Pachinko, was a finalist for a National Book Award.

item.title: Russell Brand is convicted of rape, and judge says he'll get a prison term
item.description: A prosecutor described Brand as a ruthless, calculating, manipulative "sexual predator." Brand, 51, denied the charges, saying he had never forced anyone to do something against their will.

item.title: Trump's arch is on the verge of federal approval. But a judge could block construction
item.description: A federal panel will meet to consider the arch for final approval on Thursday, and the government said it may begin construction later that same day. Critics hope a judge will intervene last-minute.

item.title: Bob Dylan comes knockin' on pope's door as Leo welcomes legend to Vatican
item.description: The American singer-songwriter and poet visited with the American pope at the Vatican during a break between concert dates in Italy. The Vatican said the encounter was brief.

item.title: 'I was partying too much': Jordan Firstman knows firsthand about being a 'Club Kid'
item.description: Firstman's new film is about a gay party promoter whose life is upended when he discovers he has a young son. "Arlo teaches Peter to grow up, and I think Peter teaches Arlo to be a kid," he says.
